response.overview: Actors from different countries, participating in an international screen test in Sweden, are comprehensively auditioning for major film roles, all together composing the vast story of a very valuable brooch and following the destinies of all people who in one way or another have been connected to that brooch, starting with the Second World War and ending nowadays – when the current legal ownership of the precious brooch is highly disputed.
response.tagline: Actors from different countries, participating in an international screen test in Sweden.
response.title: SCREEN TEST
